mods.description: One crawlspace per floor, the way the game intends - but one you can actually get to. [h1]The problem[/h1] A crawlspace is not placed as a crawlspace. Per floor the engine picks a room and, inside it, a single grid index . A crawlspace appears only if the rock at that index gets broken. Nothing checks what is standing on that index. Most of the time it lands on bare floor, on a wall, or on an immovable block - and there is nothing there to break. The floor's one crawlspace is unreachable, and you never learn it existed. [h1]The fix[/h1] Still one crawlspace per floor. Still dug out of a rock. The difference is that it is guaranteed to be somewhere you can reach: One room is chosen per floor, from the rooms actually on the map . The mod creates and stores a 13x13 matrix of every grid index that a room can occupy, and it populates it with all existing rooms whenever a level is loaded. When the player enters a new room, the mod searches for paths from a door to any potential secret room entrances.
